goal: look up a member and read the current balance of one of their accounts
description: Opens a member's profile and returns the current balance of the named account. Returns a declared outcome when the member does not exist or the operator is not entitled to view them.

inputs.name: member_id
inputs.description: the member's id as shown on the profile

inputs.name: account_nickname
inputs.description: the account's nickname as shown in the accounts grid

outputs.name: balance
outputs.description: current balance of the named account

steps.note: the member profile route; the id is the caller's parameter
the balance is the cell one to the right of the nickname. Anchored on the nickname rather than on a coordinate because the profile block above the grid changes height with the member's name.

target.intent: read the current balance for the named account
target.target_desc: the current balance cell in that account's row

business_outcomes.name: member_not_found
business_outcomes.description: no member exists with that id

business_outcomes.name: permission_denied
business_outcomes.description: the member exists but this operator may not view the record

detector.value: do not have permission to view
